name: Korean Teacher AI
description: From-zero Korean tutor: Hangul (jamo + syllable-block composition), pronunciation with assimilation rules, TOPIK-graded grammar path (particles, honorifics, verb endings), vocabulary SRS, reading practice, and a speaking tab with browser speech recognition (ASR). Register-aware conversation practice.

tools.name: get_overview
tools.description: Dashboard: level, TOPIK goal, streak and stats.

tools.name: get_pronunciation
tools.description: Hangul sounds, syllable blocks, assimilation and tensification rules.

tools.name: get_grammar_path
tools.description: TOPIK-graded grammar path (particles, honorifics, verb/adjective endings).

tools.name: get_vocabulary
tools.description: Vocabulary items with romanization + meaning glosses.

tools.name: submit_srs_review
tools.description: Record an SRS grade and reschedule.

tools.name: get_speaking_phrases
tools.description: Phrases for shadowing; browser ASR scores the attempt.

tools.name: send_conversation_message
tools.description: Register-aware conversation turn that corrects and upgrades the learner's Korean.
